title: Kouka: the low tide near the Graffiti alley
summary: Kouka saw the low tide near the Graffiti alley this week (fiction).
body:
Scanner caught the dip near the Graffiti alley. Same shape as always: a few seconds a pass, inland, evening. No carrier, no hum. If you are at the Graffiti alley after dark, watch the lamps and tell me which one goes first.

Fiction: a story notice from the city of Noctiluca. Not a real event, and nothing here was measured.
